statement: admin.shopify.com/login reflects an attacker-controlled redirect parameter into a redirect (open redirect)
observation: control and variant both 403 (bot challenge), no Location header; transient 502 on first variant run did not reproduce
why_failed: endpoint behind 'Verifying your connection' challenge; redirect param never processed

statement: www.shopify.com/?q= reflects input into the <script> JSON blob without escaping </script> (reflected XSS via script breakout)
observation: q=<zz> -> 302 to CF worker-challenge URL; q=</script> -> 403 CF challenge page; plain token reflected once inside script JSON with proper escaping
why_failed: edge WAF challenges any angle brackets in q before app logic; markup never reaches the reflection sink

statement: accounts.shopify.com/oauth/authorize accepts a tampered redirect_uri for the first-party partners client_id (OAuth redirect_uri bypass -> code theft)
observation: legit redirect_uri -> 302 to /signup?rid=; tampered (evil.com, subdomain-confusion, userinfo) -> 400 invalid_request 'redirect_uri mismatch'; nonce reuse ruled out (baseline replay still 302)
why_failed: strict allowlist validation per client_id; explicit mismatch error page

statement: the OAuth invalid_request error page echoes the rejected redirect_uri without HTML-escaping (reflected XSS on accounts.shopify.com)
observation: non-URI redirect_uri -> bare 400 (11B, no echo); URI-shaped markup -> 400 details page but echo is percent-encoded (zzqxj9%22%3E%3Csvg%3E)
why_failed: error page echoes the raw encoded query string; percent-encoding neutralizes markup

statement: www.shopify.com trusts X-Forwarded-Host and reflects it into page URLs (host-header poisoning -> cache poisoning / link hijack)
observation: GET / with X-Forwarded-Host: evil.example.com -> 200, zero occurrences of injected host in 639KB body
why_failed: edge/app ignores XFH; absolute URLs built from real host

statement: www.shopify.com sets cookies scoped to .shopify.com that an attacker-influenced subdomain/page could toss to poison admin/accounts sessions (cookie-tossing primitive)
observation: GET / -> 200, zero Set-Cookie headers in response
why_failed: marketing host sets no cookies at all

statement: the locale param on /signup is reflected unescaped or alters the OAuth redirect chain (XSS / redirect manipulation via locale)
observation: locale -> passed as locales= (URL-encoded) into authorize 302; authorize 302s normally to /signup?rid=; rid page is CF-challenged (403); no unescaped reflection anywhere observable
why_failed: values percent-encoded in transit; render surface behind bot challenge

observation: GET /prod, /v1, /api on api.qa.cmi.aol.com all return 403 {"message":"Forbidden"} — identical to /. No deployed stage reachable. (Note: mid-test sandbox egress outage caused transient 000s; retried after recovery with 12s spacing.)
why_failed: API Gateway has no reachable stages under common names; 403 uniform across / and stage paths

statement: A Yahoo/AOL API subdomain reflects an arbitrary Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true, enabling cross-origin theft of authenticated responses
observation: GET query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/AAPL with evil Origin returned 429 Too Many Requests (no CORS headers in 429). Edge is rate-limiting this egress IP after earlier sweeps.

statement: beta.api.login.yahoo.com (older/secondary API version) validates requests more weakly than api.login.yahoo.com — e.g. different auth requirements, verbose errors, or missing rate limits on the same endpoints
